title: Can We Jump from Cross-Sectional to Dynamic Interpretations of Networks? Implications for the Network Perspective in Psychiatry
limitations: - The study only compared cross-sectional and dynamic networks, not different types of cross-sectional networks; - The study did not report on the statistical significance of the differences in centrality estimates between network types; - The study did not use a formal statistical test to compare centrality estimates between groups.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the paper, but the authors may have made them available through supplementary materials or repositories. The study used STATA for analysis and R for visualization, but the specific packages used for network estimation are not fully detailed.
